ui.settings.model.model_setting_options..tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.

placeholders.aggregated: Select token "yes" or "no". yes: the model is reached through an aggregator. Never translate the tokens yes/no.
placeholders.credential: Select token "unknown", "missing" or "signed_in". missing: no usable credential; signed_in: a credential is held; unknown: say nothing about it. Never translate the tokens.
placeholders.provider: Provider display name, for example "OpenRouter". Insert verbatim.
